verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic uncaught-error capture via client libraries for backend (Ruby gem/CLI) and frontend (JS with source-map support), plus a generic HTTP API for reporting exceptions from any platform. However, there is no explicit evidence of dedicated official mobile app SDKs (iOS/Android) capturing uncaught errors automatically. Missing for 10: explicit mobile SDK documentation, evidence of multi-language backend SDK breadth, and independent hands-on confirmation of automatic capture across platforms.
